name: Atomscale
description:
Atomscale is a cloud platform for materials characterization and metrology
data from thin-film growth and processing: RHEED, SEM, XPS, Raman, photoluminescence, ellipsometry, OES, instrument logs and recipes, tool trace, and more.

This connector lets Claude work with your Atomscale organization directly.
Search the data catalogue and physical samples, pull processed analysis
results and similarity embeddings for any data item, tag and annotate data,
create and edit Python (marimo) analysis notebooks, upload new files, and
manage live streams from instruments with the capability to read and write feedback.

Every request is scoped to your Atomscale account: tools act as you, within
your organization, with the same permissions as the web app. Read tools are
marked read-only; write tools are annotated so Claude asks before making
changes. Sign in with your Atomscale account on first connect (OAuth), or use
an API key for headless clients.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Atomscale to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Atomscale to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.atomscale.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Atomscale MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Atomscale lists 16 MCP tools, including annotate_data, create_notebook, edit_notebook, fetch_data, fetch_embeddings, fetch_notebook, fetch_results, fetch_sample, list_notebooks, ping, push_stream_chunk, and search_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Atomscale?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Atomscale in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Atomscale requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Atomscale is developed by Atomscale. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
